title: 모듈 생성 및 기본 설정
markdown:
### 1. 기본 폴더 생성 - service - comment 모듈 및 기본 폴더 생성 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8193-b7bf-f7502159528c/945633542d54552e.webp)
1. build.gradle ```groovy dependencies { implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-web' implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-data-jpa' runtimeOnly 'com.mysql:mysql-connector-j' implementation project(':common:snowflake') } ```
2. main.java.sub.board.comment.CommentApplication 파일 정의 ```java package sub.board.comment; import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication; import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication; import org.springframework.context.annotation.ComponentScan; import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.config.EnableJpaRepositories; @ComponentScan(basePackages = "sub.board") @EnableJpaRepositories(basePackages = "sub.board") @SpringBootApplication public class CommentApplication { public static void main(String[] args) { SpringApplication.run(CommentApplication.class, args); } } ```
3. resources.application.yml 파일 정의 ```yaml server: port: 9001 spring: application: name: sub-board-article-service datasource: driver-class-name: com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver url: jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/mydb username: ${MYSQL_USERNAME} password: ${MYSQL_PASSWORD} jpa: database-platform: org.hibernate.dialect.MySQLDialect open-in-view: false show-sql: false hibernate: ddl-auto: none ```
### 2. 모듈 등록 1. File - Project Structure ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8193-b7bf-f7502159528c/2e1ed992a36723b2.webp) 1. 모듈 import ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8193-b7bf-f7502159528c/07d0211b9225aff4.webp) 1. 추가하려는 폴더(모듈) 선택 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8193-b7bf-f7502159528c/b12027b82a5bac7d.webp) 1. import module from external model - Gradle - Create 클릭 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8193-b7bf-f7502159528c/80a4e14ababfa3ce.webp) 1. 모듈 등록 확인 후, OK 클릭 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8193-b7bf-f7502159528c/4eff6c78c9b74ba3.webp) ### 3. gradle 에 해당 모듈 등록 - root - settings.gradle 파일에 새로 생성한 모듈(comment) 등록 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8193-b7bf-f7502159528c/66e02ae24155a398.webp) settings.gradle ```groovy rootProject.name = 'large-board' include 'common' include 'common:snowflake' include 'service' include 'service:article' include 'service:comment' ``` 해당 모듈 boot 실행을 통해 정상 동작 확인하기 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8193-b7bf-f7502159528c/8240b3713e81ea00.webp) - boot 실행을 통해 정상 동작 확인함
